messages.content: amar friend group e ekjon ache jake ami actually pochondo kori na kintu bolte parina
Ki karone pochondo koro na, jodi bolte iccha koro?
onek negative energy niye ashe always, drain feel kori
That drain is a real signal worth listening to. Puro group theke distance rakhার dorkar nai, just ei ekjon er sathe interaction limit kore dite paro subtly.
kivabe korbo eta obvious na kore?
One-on-one hangout gulo gradually kome ashuk, group setting e normal thako - eta natural distance create kore without any dramatic confrontation.
